game_concept: A tower defense set in Sand Dunes – Dry Well, a nearly dry well: the sand ranger must handle sand wyrms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Integration Heist: Combine loops, conditionals, and lists to complete a multi-step script that raids Dry Well.
theme: Sand Dunes – Dry Well: a nearly dry well
core_gameplay_loop: In Dry Well, repeat each round: Combine loops, conditionals, and lists to complete a multi-step script that raids Dry Well. Each round, sand wyrms strike the supply tent, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the heist value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the supply tent from sand wyrms in Dry Well: keep the heist meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 31-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: heist drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 31-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 4 (applied tier): Integration Heist
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Integration Heist' (Week 9 slot 7), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Dry Well'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how heist changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against sand wyrms in Dry Well.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 31 seconds while heist > 0.
